documento: Internal reporting channel | Provincial Council of Granada
zona: Public access · Provincial Council of Granada
intro: Access the Provincial Council of Granada's internal reporting system and read its rules.
accion_descripcion: If you wish to report a possible breach learned of in a work or professional context, use the Council's channel. You may report anonymously.
salida: The link opens an external website. Reports and follow-up are handled there.
ambito_que: The channel receives information about possible criminal offences, serious or very serious administrative offences, and other matters covered by Spanish Law 2/2023.
ambito_quien: It is for people who learned of the facts in a work or professional context, including before or after their relationship with the organisation.
ambito_duda: The institutional system decides whether to admit each report. For routine personnel procedures, use the appropriate procedure.
ambito_acoso: If you need to start a harassment procedure, consult the institution's specific route. This link does not replace that procedure.
ambito_externo: Spanish Law 2/2023 also allows reports through the competent authority's external channels.
privacidad_anonima: You can reach the channel without signing in to VEC or identifying yourself on this page. The law allows anonymous reports.
privacidad_sin_datos: This page does not request facts, names, documents or contact details. The institutional system handles reports under its own safeguards.
institucional: Institutional page for the Internal Reporting System ↗
ley: Spanish Law 2/2023 on protection of reporting persons ↗
ayuda_texto: Select “Open the institutional channel” to go to the Council's system. You will find reporting and follow-up options there.
ayuda_problema: If the link does not open, consult the institutional page listed under “Information and rules”.
